Even though we won we had to leave the track since Annalie looked like she was concussed. 
I didn’t listen to my own advice of not taking things too seriously, and someone ended up injured…
Fortunately, the doctor said that Annalie was fine and should be back to normal after some rest.
That’s the second time she got hurt while hanging out with us…
Maybe she’s just a clutz?
